Game Overview

In Lines, the core idea is straightforward: strategically clear a grid by aligning five or more same-colored balls in Lines. New balls appear, intensifying each turn. Master the art of foresight to create longer lines for higher scores. Enjoy vibrant colors and endless puzzle challenges that will test your planning and keep you engaged.
